## Outcome

The thread matches the design (`reference/screens/fullbleed-1440-{dark,light}-thread.png`, `-failed-send.png`, `-empty-channel.png`; 390 variants):
- `--bg-2` background
- runs with `first`/`mid`/`last-of` classes and 18/6px corners
- the name line on the first row: name, `#id`, a `YOUR MACHINE`/`KEVIN'S MACHINE` tag or a `HUMAN` tag, and the time
- the avatar on the last row only, with the harness logo and owner badge
- viewer bubbles right-aligned in blue, with no avatar
- other humans' bubbles pink
- agents grey, including the viewer's agents
- clickable `@mentions`
- inline `code`
- day separators "**Today** 10:02 AM"
- one receipt: `Delivered` or `Not sent` with a retry button
- event rows as `.kh-ev` pills

## Scope

1. **Runs** (`features/timeline/runs.ts`, pure): given a row list (messages and non-messages), compute per message `{ first, mid, lastOf, showName, showAvatar, ghost }` with the §7.1 rules:
   - `first` = the previous item is not a message from the same participant
   - `last` = the next item is not a message from the same participant
   - classes: `first` when first; `mid` when neither first nor last; `last-of` when last but not first
   - `showName = first && !isViewer`
   - avatar: none when `isViewer`, `ghost` when not last
2. **Ownership:** `.me` only when `participant.kind === 'human' && participant.participantId === viewer.participantId`; `.human` for other humans. The viewer's agents are plain agent rows. *(Changes `TimelineScreen.tsx:358`; keep `ownershipLabel` for `aria-label`.)*
3. **`ChatMessage`** renders the §7.1 DOM:
   - `div.kh-row` with an avatar `button` from KM-180's `Avatar`, then `div.kh-col`, then the optional `button.kh-name` and `div.kh-b`.
   - Name line:
     - agent: `<b>{label}</b>`, an optional `.kh-id`, then `<span class="kh-otag" style="--oh">{Your machine | {OwnerFirst}’s machine}</span>`, then the bare time text
     - human: `<b>{display name}</b><span class="kh-htag">Human</span>{time}`
   - The label and owner come from KM-135's attribution: the display name `Claude · Kevin` splits to label `Claude` and owner `Kevin`. Use `kh-id` only for the collision suffix from `buildDisplayNameResolver` (`features/timeline/attribution.ts:53-65`).
   - Time is `clockLabel` (KM-180). `title` and `dateTime` hold the full ISO time.
4. **Mentions** (`features/timeline/mentions.ts`, pure): `segmentMentions(text, roster)` returns `Array<{ text } | { mention, participantId, kind, hue }>`.
   - It matches `@` plus a **known** label (agent label or human first name), longest first, case-insensitive, at a word boundary.
   - `renderMessageContent` (`features/timeline/message-renderer.tsx:30-50`) renders mention segments as `<span class="kh-mention [kh-hm]" style="--mh" role="button" tabindex="0">@{label}</span>`.
   - Single-backtick spans become `<code>`.
   - Fences stay as they are, with `<pre class="kh-pre">` and `<span class="kh-pre-lang">` (§7.3).
   - Keep the KTD4 inert-rendering rules (`message-renderer.tsx:1-8`).
   - A mention click calls the `onOpenParticipant(participantId)` prop. **KM-183** wires the detail pane; until then it is a no-op.
5. **Day separators:** insert `<div class="kh-day" role="separator"><b>{dayLabel}</b> {dayTime}</div>` before the first message of each local calendar day, using KM-180 `format-time.ts`.
6. **Receipt** (§7.4): exactly one, after the viewer's last message.

   | Phase | Render |
   |---|---|
   | `pending` | `Sending…`, bubble opacity .7 |
   | `accepted`/reconciled | `Delivered` |
   | `failed` | row `.failed` + `button.kh-ib.sm.kh-retry` (restore icon, `aria-label="Retry"`, `data-tip="Retry"`) + `.kh-rcpt.kh-fail` `Not sent` |
   | `outcome_unknown` | the same as failed, with tooltip and label "Check delivery" and text `Delivery unknown` |

   The `aria-label`s keep the existing button semantics (`TimelineScreen.tsx:395-404`). The receipt has `role="status"`. Never render "Read".
7. **Events:**
   - `ChatSystemEvent` (agent rename) becomes `<div class="kh-ev kh-ev--static"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>{Old} is now {New} · {Actor} · {h:mm}</div>`, with `.kh-ev--static { cursor: default }` and `.kh-ev--static i { background: var(--muted) }`.
   - In `thread.css`, restyle KM-172's pill to the §8 `.kh-ev` values: `.channel-event-pill__link` gets the `.kh-ev` box. Map the dots: `--success` → `--good`, `--failure` → `--block`, `--attention` → `--attn`, `--pending` → `--accent`, `--info` → `--muted`. Text is `.76rem` `--muted`; the hover border is `--line-strong`.
8. **Empty and unavailable states:**
   - empty thread → `.kh-empty` "No messages yet" plus `.kh-btn.pri` "Invite", which calls `onInvite` (KM-183 opens the invite popover)
   - history unavailable → `.kh-state-c` with "Conversation history is unavailable right now." + `.kh-btn` "Retry"
   - access lost → the `removed` card copy "You no longer have access to this conversation." (§13.2)
9. `.kh-row.pop` on rows that arrive live while at latest. Remove it after the animation.
10. **Composer call site:** pass `mentionTargets` (the KM-184 contract) built from the roster. Delete the `participants=` pills (`TimelineScreen.tsx:422-432`).
11. Copy §7.2, §7.3, §7.4, §8 and §13.1/§13.2 CSS verbatim into `ui/khala/thread.css`. Delete `features/channel/channel.css:55-66` and the bubble rules in `features/timeline/timeline.css:59-101`.

## Non-goals

- Composer and chips: **KM-184**.
- Header, roster and detail pane: **KM-183**. Only the `onOpenParticipant`/`onInvite` callbacks are exposed here.
- C3 attribution data: **KM-135**.
- Event decoding and pill markup: **KM-172**.
- Typing indicator, reactions, `.kh-ask` and the Read receipt: [M2]/never (§22). Do not build them.

## Contract and invariants

C3 (contracts.md, quoted):

```ts
| { matrixUserId: string; participantId: string; ownerId: string; displayName: string; kind: 'agent'; ownerLabel: string; harness: Harness }
```

- `ownerLabel` drives the otag (`{ownerLabel}’s machine`, with U+2019), or "Your machine" when `ownerId === viewer.ownerId`.
- `harness` picks the avatar logo.
- An `unknown` participant renders the name `Unknown` with no tag and the `kh-ini` monogram.

### Worked example

Rows: an agent message at 10:03, the same agent at 10:04, then a viewer message at 10:08 (accepted). Agent `Sonnet · Kevin`, viewer Kevin.

```html
<div class="kh-day" role="separator"><b>Today</b> 10:03 AM</div>
<div class="kh-row first" title="…"><span class="kh-av ghost" aria-hidden="true"></span><div class="kh-col"><button type="button" class="kh-name" style="--h:210" aria-label="Sonnet, your agent, 10:03"><b>Sonnet</b><span class="kh-otag" style="--oh:214">Your machine</span>10:03</button><div class="kh-b">State + auth lands in ~20m.</div></div></div>
<div class="kh-row last-of"><button type="button" class="kh-av" style="--h:210" aria-label="Sonnet details"><img src="…claude-symbol.svg" alt=""><span class="kh-own" style="--oh:214">KE</span></button><div class="kh-col"><div class="kh-b">Soft blocker on <span class="kh-mention" style="--mh:150" role="button" tabindex="0">@Opus</span> merge.</div></div></div>
<div class="kh-row me first"><div class="kh-col"><div class="kh-b">I’ll review it now.</div></div></div>
<div class="kh-rcpt" role="status">Delivered</div>
```

### Steps

1. Write `runs.ts` and `mentions.ts` with their tests first.
2. Update `ChatMessage`/`ChatSystemEvent`/`ChatThread` to the §7.1/§8 DOM. Keep the `data-event-id` and `aria-live` behaviour.
3. Change `TimelineScreen` to use runs, the new `.me` rule, day separators, receipts, `.pop` and `mentionTargets`.
4. Extend `message-renderer.tsx` for mentions, inline code and `.kh-pre`.
5. Copy the CSS and delete the superseded rules.
6. Compare with `reference/screens/fullbleed-*-{thread,failed-send,empty-channel}.png` at 1440 and 390, in both themes.

## Test scenarios

- `features/timeline/runs.test.ts`:
  1. A single message → `first` only, name shown, avatar not ghost.
  2. Three in a row → `first`/`mid`/`last-of`, name on the first, ghosts on the first two.
  3. An event between two messages from the same sender gives two separate `first` rows.
  4. A viewer message → no avatar and no name.
- `features/timeline/mentions.test.ts`:
  1. `@Opus said` with Opus known → a mention segment, then ` said`.
  2. `@nobody` → plain text.
  3. With `Kai` and `Kai Bot` both known, `@Kai Bot` matches the longer label.
  4. `mail@kai.dev` is not a mention.
- `features/timeline/message-renderer.test.tsx`:
  1. `` `useSession()` `` → `<code>`.
  2. A fence → `pre.kh-pre`.
  3. No `a`, `img` or `iframe` is ever created (keep the existing assertions).
- `features/timeline/TimelineScreen.test.tsx`:
  1. The viewer's agent message does **not** have `.me` and shows `Your machine`.
  2. Exactly one `.kh-rcpt`, after the last viewer message.
  3. A failed send → `.failed`, a Retry button and `Not sent`; clicking Retry calls `retrySend`.
  4. `outcome_unknown` → "Check delivery" and `Delivery unknown`.
  5. A day separator appears before the first message.
  6. The empty thread shows `No messages yet` and an `Invite` button.
  7. Read receipts are never rendered.
- `features/timeline/timeline.browser.spec.ts`: at 1440, the computed styles match `reference/computed-styles.json["1440-dark"]` for `.kh-row:not(.me):not(.human) .kh-b`, `.kh-row.me .kh-b`, `.kh-name b`, `.kh-otag` and `.kh-rcpt`. Colour, font-size, padding and border-radius must be exact.

**Done when:** the thread at 1440 and 390, in both themes, matches the reference images for every element in **Outcome**. All fonts are Space Grotesk or JetBrains Mono, with no Bungee.

## Risks and stop conditions

- If KM-135's attribution shape differs from C3, stop and ask. Do not adapt C3 locally.
- If KM-172 has not merged, still ship the `.channel-event-pill` overrides. They are inert until the pill exists.
- If mention matching flags a performance problem (over 2 ms per message at 500 messages), memoize per roster and stop if that is still slow.

## Complexity rationale

3: it touches the core message rendering, adds two pure helpers with edge cases, and must merge cleanly with KM-135 and KM-172.
